sources.feature_id: Image of Purdue Alpha Eta chapter during recruitment; 40.429528,-86.916583 camera position
sources.measurement_method: Visual facade reference; image and heading metadata inspected; no dimensions inferred.
sources.observation: The geolocated photo specifically captions the Purdue Alpha Eta chapter house. Visible details include dark red-brown brick, stone-arched recessed entrance, strong horizontal facade band, and mullioned windows. Camera stood southeast of the mapped footprint and faced northwest.
sources.uncertainty: Close framing cuts off roof and full building; exact entrance bearing and all dimensions remain unverified.

sources.provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
sources.feature_id: Milton Lauenstein photographs, Item 18: Alpha Xi Delta House
sources.measurement_method: Finding aid title/date only; image not geometrically interpreted.
sources.observation: Official archive catalog confirms a 1945 photograph titled Alpha Xi Delta House.
sources.uncertainty: No image was directly available and the catalog does not provide a spatial tie.

transform.axes: X east, Y north, Z up

measurements.base_ring_match: 24/24 GIS vertices matched the bottom of the wall mesh; decorative roof/entry pieces extend slightly beyond the GIS line.

geometry_edits: Rebuilt House_301841248 with the exact FID 788 GIS base ring and identity object transform.
Replaced unverified 16 m massing with a two-level brick facade and estimated 12.3 m hipped roof.
Added source-backed stone-arched entry, recessed dark door, horizontal band, and mullioned windows; unsupported full facade and roof details remain schematic.
uncertainties: The official GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with two facade levels visible in the photo; its field definition is unknown.
Roof form and exact vertical dimensions cannot be verified from the cropped photograph.
Facade/entry compass bearing is illustrative; the photo camera is southeast and heading 310 degrees, but does not show the entire wall elevation.
The 1945 official archive record was not used for geometry because its photo was unavailable.
